layer_1_style.description: High-poly 3D animation style, cinematic CGI, smooth clay textures, soft studio lighting, tactile 'handmade' feel.

layer_3_action.subject: Troodon big eye morphology
features: A close-up of a friendly green clay Troodon face
One very large, prominent, and glassy black clay eye with a soft amber iris
The eye is oversized to emphasize night vision, filling much of the upper head
Friendly, slight smile with rounded clay snout
Texture includes subtle clay 'fingerprint' swirls to enhance the handmade look
Soft, warm highlights on the surface of the eye to make it look kind and soulful
layer_3_action.action: A centered, cinematic macro shot focusing on the large eye. The background is a soft, warm neutral gradient. The lighting is gentle, designed to be inviting for children ages 4-6. No text.
